Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a new production sprite sheet of eight ANGRY speech-mouth drawings for MIST, the minimalist cyan robot face. Output a landscape 2:1 image, exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows in an invisible regular grid of eight equal square cells. OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background. Exactly ONE mouth in each cell, no eyes, no faces, no words, no labels, no borders. Eight single connected solid CYAN #45E2DF silhouettes, clean antialiased edges. No gradients, glow, texture, teeth, tongue, notches, tabs, cutouts, internal linework, holes, floating dots, islands or multiple strokes.

Emotion: controlled anger, stern tension, not sadness and definitely not happiness. Tense shapes with blunt, rounded-angular corners, no cheerful lifted corners, no U-shaped smiling bowls, no grin. Upper and lower contours remain smooth continuous strokes without little dents. All eight horizontal centers exactly aligned to the centers of their respective cells, uppermost ink near 42% cell height, comparable consistent character scale. Generous white margins. Read order top row left-to-right, then bottom row left-to-right:
1 REST: tight stern pressed lip; almost horizontal thick short line, center just slightly higher than its gently downturned outer ends; width 50% cell, height 8%. No smiling rise at corners.
2 RELEASE: narrow compressed rounded lozenge with straight tense upper/lower middle, slightly lowered corners, width 43%, height 8%. Modest opening.
3 SMALL_AA: modest open tense rounded rectangle, upper edge nearly flat and shoulders slightly downturned, lower edge nearly flat, width 45%, height 16%. Avoid a semicircle or smile bowl.
4 AA: clearly open angry vowel, taller blunt rounded rectangle with minimally tapered lower sides and near-flat upper and lower middle, width 50%, height 27%. No happy raised corners.

8 WIDE_CLOSE: broad compressed stern mouth, width 55%, height 7%, almost straight across with subtle downturned ends, no smile.

The mouths must visibly belong to one angry emotional family yet show distinct speech aperture sizes. Keep clean solid flat cyan robot-drawing style. All interior areas filled cyan. Each cell must contain exactly one silhouette. No repeated smiling source bowls.
